title: Tomb Raider IV-VI Remastered
notes: Works like a charm. Played on 120fps for a lot of time and I use joystick and vibration works. Even can ⌘+tab and use external display as second screen to watch a movie while playing. Just remember to enable for joystick on highball settings or disable keyboard Mission Control shortcuts if you wanna play this game.
issues: You need to disable keyboard Mission Control shortcuts if you wanna play this game on keyboard.

title: Tomb Raider IV-VI Remastered
notes: Angel of Darkness runs on a different game engine than 4 and 5 Played through some of the first level on modern graphics.
issues: There are small pauses during gameplay when certain things are loaded such as Lara's next voice line. There is a hatching pattern on Lara's shadow
